slides.title: Tuesday, Nov 17: Two Big Tests
slides.body: Census reports October retail sales at 8:30 a.m. ET. Nvidia reports quarterly results after the close (call at 5 p.m. ET), its first since its CEO change. Home Depot reports before the open.

slides.title: 10-Year Yield Keeps Climbing
slides.subtitle: Treasury 10-year yield, daily close (%)
slides.body: Nov 11 was a bond-market holiday. Freddie Mac's 30-year mortgage rate was 7.11% on Nov 12.

slides.title: Wednesday, Nov 18: Fed Minutes
slides.body: The Fed publishes notes from its Oct 27-28 meeting. Markets price about an 87% chance of a December hike (CME FedWatch via CNBC, Nov 13). That is an estimate, not a decision.

slides.title: Save This: Week Checklist
items: Mon: Warsh speaks. Tue: retail sales, Nvidia.
Wed: housing starts, Fed minutes 2 p.m.
Thu: Jefferson speaks. Fri: Cook speaks.
